design.sessionOwnership: One registry SessionOwner opaque per WebView2Runtime/BrowserSession; every identity carries that owner.
design.pageOwnership: Exact guard.PageIdentity in the host-native path.
design.documentGeneration: Host-minted opaque Guid per protected lifecycle, plus isolated fixed-producer generation nonce; engine uniqueId, not numeric executionContextId, for native checkpoint dispatch.
design.ordering: Monotonic producer revision per exact WeakMap control; complete values remembered before stale/retired current rejection. Duplicate same-revision conflicting value is denied.
design.terminal: Immutable host snapshot with exact identity/revision/value/reason; host instance reference witness must equal current confirmed snapshot. Commit never looks up arbitrary pending.
design.hostScalarReason: HOST_CONFIRMED only for old internal explicit commit=true producer; rejected from page/CDP messages.
design.retire: Use already-confirmed exact-current snapshot, otherwise preserve known TRANSIENT. No terminal fabricated from disappearance.
design.checkpoint: Single exact protected world, unique engine context, fresh nonce, explicit snapshot list+generation and exact ack, coverage and immutable snapshot validation, then Commit.
design.redactionPolicy: Unchanged 1..3 exact-leaf TRANSIENT, >=4 substring, COMMITTED short denial. Host-private only.
